name: Keyflower

categories.label: Points from village tiles (printed scoring)
categories.labelVi: Điểm từ ô làng (theo giá trị in trên ô)
categories.hint: Sum all tile bonuses in your village: barn, blacksmith, stone yard, timber yard (kept resources), plus other scoring tiles. Each resource, skill or worker scores once only.

categories.label: Points from boats and turn-order tiles
categories.labelVi: Điểm từ thuyền và ô thứ tự lượt
categories.hint: Boat tile points (e.g. Keyflower, Sea Bastion, Sea Breeze, Flipper, Invincible) and 1 point per connected tile for each owned turn-order tile.

categories.label: Unallocated gold counters
categories.labelVi: Vàng chưa dùng cho ô tính điểm
categories.hint: 1 point per gold counter not assigned to any scoring tile.

tiebreakers.description: Players with equal points are tied and should play again to decide the winner.

notes: family: tile-sum. Game ends at the end of winter. Printed tile values vary per tile and are entered as totals; individual tile values not modelled. Gold used as a resource on barn/blacksmith/stone yard/timber yard does not also score 1 point. Every scoring tile except the Keythedral can score its bonus multiple times if enough resources, skills or workers exist. Purple start player marker may count as a resource, skill or worker of any colour. Expansions (Farmers, Merchants) not modelled.

sources.title: Keyflower rulebook (English, via 1jour-1jeu)
